mapper.select:
with REMINDER_SET as ( SELECT SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE, SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET.DAYS as DAYS FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET ) SELECT (
SELECT count(*) FROM PRD_SALE_PARAM LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON PRD_SALE_PARAM.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S1}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = PRD_SALE_PARAM.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
WHERE PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_VDATE <= #{quaryDate} AND PRD_SALE_PARAM.FIRST_SALE_MDATE >= #{quaryDate} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R1S1} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PRD_SALE_PARAM.FINPROD_ID ) ) as R1S1, (
SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S2}
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
WHERE( FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE <= #{quaryDate}+REMINDER_SET.DAYS OR FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS = '03'
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C1} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01})
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R1S2} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID ) )as R1S2, (
SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S3}
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
WHERE( FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= #{quaryDate}+REMINDER_SET.DAYS OR FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= #{quaryDate} ) AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_TYPE = #{cashType_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE in(#{profitType_02},#{profitType_03}) AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1_02} AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT.Mdate > #{quaryDate}
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND (TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C7} OR TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C9} OR TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = 'C10') AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} )
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R1S3} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.MDATE = FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE ) ) as R1S3, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT #{R1S4} as remType, SUM(TPRD.PRIN_AMT) as AMT, fp2.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, fp2.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, TPRD.MDATE || '子周期到期' as reminder, TPRD.BRANCH as BRANCH, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID as menuId, REMINDER_SET.URL as url, REMINDER_SET.LABLE as lable, REMINDER_SET.DEALF as dealF, REMINDER_SET.CLOSF as closF, REMINDER_SET.DAYS as days FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPRD LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON TPRD.FINPROD_ID = fp1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN fin_product fp2 ON fp1.P_FINPROD_ID = fp2.finprod_id LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = PA_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON fp2.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = fp2.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET REMINDER_SET WHERE REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S4} and TPRD.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+REMINDER_SET.DAYS AND TPRD.MDATE >= #{quaryDate} AND TPRD.PS in (#{ps_C1},#{ps_C2}) AND TPRD.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TPRD.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} AND fp2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} AND PA_FIN_PRODUCT.DEAL_MODE in (#{dispose_10},#{dispose_12})
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R1S4} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = fp2.FINPROD_ID AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.MDATE = TPRD.MDATE )
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD WHERE TPD.PS = #{ps_C4} AND TPD.FINPROD_ID = TPRD.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.BRANCH = TPRD.BRANCH AND TPD.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} ) GROUP BY fp2.FINPROD_ID , fp2.FINPROD_NAME , TPRD.MDATE, TPRD.BRANCH, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID, REMINDER_SET.URL, REMINDER_SET.LABLE , REMINDER_SET.DEALF , REMINDER_SET.CLOSF , REMINDER_SET.DAYS )RES
WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT RES1.* FROM( SELECT TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH as BRANCH, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID as FINPROD_ID, SUM(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PRIN_AMT) as AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PA_FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C17} AND PA_FIN_PRODUCT.DEAL_MODE in (#{dispose_10},#{dispose_12}) AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} GROUP BY TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID )RES1 WHERE RES.finprodId = RES1.FINPROD_ID AND RES.BRANCH = RES1.BRANCH AND RES.AMT <= RES1.AMT ) ) as R1S4, (
SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_PRODUCT
LEFT JOIN REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S5}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
WHERE ( FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+REMINDER_SET.DAYS OR FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} AND FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS != '02'
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C5} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01})
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R1S5} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID ) )as R1S5, (
SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT #{R1S6} as remType, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as prodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, '产品需进行:'||MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME||'('|| MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID ||')支付' as reminder, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE as mdate, MST_FEEINFO .FEE_ID as feeId, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID as menuId, REMINDER_SET.URL as url, REMINDER_SET.LABLE as lable, REMINDER_SET.DEALF as dealF, REMINDER_SET.CLOSF as closF, REMINDER_SET.DAYS as days FROM FIN_CASH_INFO INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID=FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID INNER JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID=MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND MST_FEEINFO.charge_type = #{chargeType_01} INNER JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID=BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH=BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.BRANCH AND BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FEE_TYPE = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID=FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT ON STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.FINPROD_ID=FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.CCY=FIN_CASH_INFO.CCY AND STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_TYPE = 'B12' LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT1 ON STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT1.FINPROD_ID=FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT1.CCY=FIN_CASH_INFO.CCY AND STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT1.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = #{R1S6}
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani ON dani.BUSINESS_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institution} AND dani.DATA_TYPE = 'FINPROD04'
WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1_03} AND BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP > 0 AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= #{quaryDate} AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_TYPE = #{cashType_05} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus_01} AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finType_F16} and not exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.BRANCH=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH AND BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FEE_TYPE=TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01}) AND BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.CDATE = (SELECT max(B.CDATE) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE B WHERE B.FINPROD_ID = BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FINPROD_ID AND B.BRANCH = BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.BRANCH AND B.FEE_TYPE = BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE.FEE_TYPE AND B.CDATE < FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE)
and PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}
) ) as R1S6 FROM DUAL

inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani99 on dani99.BUSINESS_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID
and dani99.institution_code in
#{item}
WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND ( T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS or T1.MDATE <= #{quaryDate} ) and T3.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F05', 'F04') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S15} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID ) ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )

SELECT count(1) R7S2 FROM ( select #{R7S2} as remType, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodId, FP.FINPROD_ID as prodId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodName, '项目类资产标的信息被修改查看' as reminder, FP.UPDATE_TIME as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS from FIN_PRODUCT FP,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 where FP.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finType_F18} and T5.REM_TYPE=#{R7S2} and FP.UPDATE_TIME<= #{quaryDate}+1 and FP.UPDATE_TIME>=#{quaryDate}-T5.DAYS and not exists (select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R7S2} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=FP.FINPROD_ID and to_char(S.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')=to_char(FP.UPDATE_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) )

SELECT fp.finprod_id finprodid, fp.finprod_market_id prodid, fp.financier financier, fp.issuer issuer, fp.finprod_name finprodname, fp.manager manager, fp.sponsor sponsor, fp.invest_adviser investadviser FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp WHERE fp.finprod_type2 IN ('F01','F06','F07','F10','F17','F18')

select org.orgid as orgId from ( SELECT DISTINCT orgId FROM( SELECT DISTINCT t2.issuer, t2.financier, t2.manager, t2.sponsor, t2.invest_adviser FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION t1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t2 ON t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID WHERE t2.issuer IS NOT NULL OR t2.financier IS NOT NULL OR t2.manager IS NOT NULL OR t2.sponsor IS NOT NULL OR t2.invest_adviser IS NOT NULL AND t2.finprod_id=#{finprodid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNPIVOT(orgId FOR NAME IN(issuer, financier, manager, sponsor,invest_adviser)) GROUP BY orgId) org join INF_ORG_NEGATIVE_NEWS t4 on org.orgid = t4.org_no left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO t5 on org.orgid = t5.customer_id where 1=1
and t4.pub_date >= to_date(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')
and t4.pub_date <= to_date(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD')+1

SELECT count(1) R3S16 FROM ( SELECT #{R3S16} as remType, tpd.TRADE_ID as assetId, fp.FINPROD_ID as assetCode, fp.FINPROD_ABBR as assetName, '债券借贷融出的券'||to_char(fcp.pay_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd')||'付息还本到期' as reminder, fcp.pay_date as mdate, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T5.DAYS FROM trd_product_deal tpd inner join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fintp on fintp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN fin_deal_target fdt ON tpd.trade_id = fdt.finprod_id inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN fin_cash_plan fcp ON fcp.finprod_id = fdt.pledge_finprod_id AND fcp.mdate > tpd.trade_date AND tpd.mdate >= fcp.mdate INNER JOIN ptl_trade pt ON tpd.trade_id = pt.busi_no
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani99 on dani99.BUSINESS_ID = tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID
and dani99.institution_code in
#{item}
,SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 WHERE T5.REM_TYPE=#{R3S16} and fcp.pay_date <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS and #{quaryDate} <= fcp.pay_date and tpd.finprod_type2 = 'F30' AND tpd.trade_status = #{tradeStatus_01} AND tpd.is_cancel = 'N' AND fcp.cash_type IN ( '01','02','03','04' ) AND ( fcp.prin_amt > 0 OR fcp.int_amt > 0) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trd_fin_product_deal_total tt INNER JOIN trd_deal_total_add ta ON tt.totle_trade_id = ta.totle_trade_id WHERE tt.trade_status = #{tradeStatus_01} AND tt.is_cancel = 'N' AND tt.mdate = fcp.mdate AND tt.finprod_id = fcp.finprod_id AND tt.portfolio_id = pt.portfolio_id AND ta.mp_finprod_id = tpd.trade_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total tt INNER JOIN wfl_trd_deal_total_add ta ON tt.totle_trade_id = ta.totle_trade_id WHERE tt.trade_status = #{tradeStatus_01} AND tt.is_cancel = 'N' AND tt.mdate = fcp.mdate AND tt.finprod_id = fcp.finprod_id AND tt.portfolio_id = pt.portfolio_id AND ta.mp_finprod_id = tpd.trade_id ) and not exists ( select S.SEQNO from SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO S where S.REM_TYPE=#{R3S16} and S.EFFFLAG=#{noFlag} and S.FINPROD_ID=tpd.FINPROD_ID and to_char(S.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')=to_char(fintp.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) )

SELECT count(1) R3S13 FROM ( select T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, T10.FINPROD_ID assetCode, T10.FINPROD_ABBR assetName, 'R3S13' as remType, to_char(T8.mdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd') || '存款到期' reminder, T5.MENU_ID as menuId, T5.URL, T5.LABLE as lable, T5.DEALF as dealF, T5.CLOSF as closF, T8.mdate AS mDate, T5.DAYS from (select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE,
t7.PAY_DATE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T1.CDATE, (T6.CASH_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ case t6.CASH_TYPE when '01' then 0 else (T6.PRIN_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt, /*还本金额*/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, (t6.INT_AMT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) intAmt, /*理论利息*/ t6.PAY_DATE from PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id=t6.finprod_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and T6.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and T6.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and T6.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' /* and T1.cdate = T6.mdate_unadjust*/ and T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP ON PSP.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCP.MDATE < T6.MDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01'
and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and FCP.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd inner join WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where tpd.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'A' AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PSP.FINPROD_ID=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID /*and FCP.CASH_ID = tpd.CASH_ID*/ and FCP.MDATE = tpd.MDATE) and t6.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID and PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName}) AND PSP.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND FCP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' and PSP.AMOUNT > 0) where T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE USER_ID = #{userName})) T7 /*add by yejiejie 2019-3-9*/ group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE /*add by yejiejie 2019-3-9*/ ) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID left join SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET T5 on T5.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13}
inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani99 on dani99.BUSINESS_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID
and dani99.institution_code in
#{item}
where 1 = 1
AND ( ( T8.MDATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS and #{quaryDate} <= T8.MDATE ) or ( T8.PAY_DATE <= #{quaryDate}+T5.DAYS and #{quaryDate} <= T8.PAY_DATE ) )
AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S13} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID ) GROUP BY T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID , T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.FINPROD_ABBR , t8.MDATE, T5.MENU_ID, URL, LABLE, DEALF, CLOSF, DAYS ORDER BY T8.MDATE /*撤销数据*/
)

select count(*) R5S3 from (SELECT C.PARA_CODE assetCode, C.PARA_NAME assetName, 'R5S3' remType, '固定值参数更新提醒' reminder, REMINDER_SET.DAYS days, REMINDER_SET.MENU_ID menuId, REMINDER_SET.URL url, REMINDER_SET.LABLE lable, REMINDER_SET.DEALF dealF, REMINDER_SET.CLOSF closF, D.NOTIFY_DATE mdate FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA C LEFT JOIN (SELECT PARA_CODE,NOTIFY_DATE FROM RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE SS WHERE SS.NOTIFY_DATE <= #{quaryDate,jdbcType= DATE}) D ON C.PARA_CODE = D.PARA_CODE LEFT JOIN SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_SET REMINDER_SET ON REMINDER_SET.REM_TYPE = 'R5S3' WHERE C.PARA_TYPE = 'FIX' and D.NOTIFY_DATE <= #{quaryDate} + REMINDER_SET.DAYS and D.NOTIFY_DATE >= #{quaryDate} and 'FIX' = 'FIX' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = 'R5S3' AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = C.PARA_CODE AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.MDATE = D.NOTIFY_DATE ))

(#{profitType_01},#{profitType_03}) AND T2.TRADE_DATE <= #{quaryDate,jdbcType=DATE} + T5.days AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S6} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID and SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.mdate = T2.TRADE_DATE ) union all select #{R3S6} as remType, T2.FINPROD_TYPE2=T3.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND T3.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{bond} AND T2.PS in (#{ps_T07},#{ps_T08},#{ps_T09}) AND T2.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} and T2.TRADE_STATUS=#{tradeStatus_01} and T3.PROFIT_TYPE in (#{profitType_01},#{profitType_03}) AND T2.TRADE_DATE <= #{quaryDate,jdbcType=DATE} + T5.days AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO WHERE SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.REM_TYPE = #{R3S6} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.EFFFLAG = #{noFlag} AND SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID and SYS_ACTIVEREMINDER_INFO.mdate = T2.TRADE_DATE )
